core_aesthetic_takeaways: The case is valuable because the myth has a clear journey structure that can drive picturebook and animation sequencing.
The red bird, white stone, sacred mountain and fire seed create a compact visual memory system.
Warm-cold contrast is the main transformation device: cold village and trials resolve into communal warmth.
For design competition work, the production process should show research, story engine, symbol taxonomy, storyboard and continuity QA.
Ethnic myth prompts must preserve cultural specificity and avoid generic fantasy substitution.
prompt_structure_lessons: Begin with the cultural context and mythic problem.
Define protagonist, guide, ritual object, landscape, obstacle and return gift as separate continuity locks.
Use a frame-by-frame temperature arc from cold to warm.
Keep one focal action per scene.
Use verified cultural terms or neutral placeholders when uncertain.

safe_exact_text_candidates: short module labels such as story synopsis, symbol system, storyboard, visual style and production path
verified cultural topic names supplied by the user
requires_source_confirmation: WeChat account metadata and watermark text
text_accuracy_policy.training_rule: Use the source for derived structure and aesthetic grammar only. Do not train full story text, original images, dialogue or unverified microcopy.

risk_controls.risk: copyright contamination from external article images
risk_controls.mitigation: Store metadata and derived aesthetic rules only; keep source URL for citation; require rights clearance before image ingestion.
Require each visual element to map to story role, cultural source or continuity lock.
Use a character bible and symbol taxonomy before generating frames.
Reserve warm glow for fire discovery and return; keep trials colder and clearer.

recommended_training_use.stage_1_curation: Keep as metadata-only external reference with source URL and no image ingestion.
recommended_training_use.stage_2_caption_tuning: Use captions to teach ethnic myth story engines, symbolic continuity and warm-cold storyboard arcs.
recommended_training_use.stage_3_lora_training: If rights are cleared later, add selected images to a short-video-aigc and Culture China subset with continuity tags.
recommended_training_use.stage_4_prompt_runtime: Retrieve when prompts mention AIGC picturebook, ethnic myth, child hero journey, Qiang culture, fire myth, Culture China or university competition process board.
